correctness.rationale: Every order-preserving order-decreasing idempotent fixes exactly {1}∪A and is the floor projection e_A, proved by monotonicity. Disjoint nonempty A,B cannot commute (evaluate at larger maximum); for commuting projections the composition is e_{A∩B}. Inclusion-maximal family is intersection closed and has unique minimal nonempty singleton {r}, forced by the fact singleton projection commutes with every member containing r. Splitting at r reduces commutation to independent left/right restriction families, and maximality forces their full Cartesian product. Induction reconstructs a unique binary search tree; index sets are precisely ancestor ideals. Catalan recursion counts the trees; s(T)=1+s(L)s(R) counts ideals and proves the size profile, sharp minimum n and exactly 2^{n-2} minimizing path trees. Independent complete clique brute force vs BST for n=2..6 agrees 1,2,5,14,42. These finite checks do not replace induction.
residual_risks: n≥2, idempotents only; not all Catalan monoid elements or partial transformations.
